in_sanskrit.name: Tikendra
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Fortress
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Tikendra एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Tikendra is a Hindu name for the God of fortresses and strongholds. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Tikina' meaning fortress and the suffix 'dra' meaning lord or ruler. This name is often given to boys to signify strength, courage, and protection.
